gaps.sentence: We stayed at ___ hotel right next to the station.
gaps.explanation: 'The station' — in a town there is usually one known station; context makes it definite.
Plural general nouns and flu (illness name) take no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ life in the countryside is much quieter.
gaps.explanation: 'Life' in a general sense takes no article: Life is hard sometimes.
'Have an eye for something' — fixed idiom with 'an'.
Both 'happiness' and 'money' are general here, so no article for either gap.

gaps.sentence: He spent three years in ___ United States.
___ Alps attract skiers from all over the world.
gaps.explanation: Mountain ranges take 'the' (the Alps), but single peaks take no article (Everest).
'The courage he showed' — the relative clause makes it definite.
